notes.title: Demo Launch Alert!!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=6V0Loi4-dJ8;full][/previewyoutube]Hi everyone!  

After a lot of feedback, playtesting, bug fixes, and plenty of bullet hell testing, we're finally launching our demo this [b]September 27, 2025[/b]!  
Be one of the first group of friends to play!

[h3]I've played the public playtest. What's new?[/h3]
• Added 40 new sets of obstacles, most of these you can experience in the late game  
• Added 2 new team abilities  
• Added fists, feet, and a few other horrifying things when you take them out of context  
• Game can now be played with one single controller. Just go to lobby and press "START"  
• More details here: https://discord.com/channels/350439842225586176/1073446764146860092/1360886313561231370

So grab your friends, hop on the couch (or use Steam Remote Play), and get ready to scream, laugh, and maybe lose a friendship or two.  
(Kaz will help you along the way 😉)


[h3]Want to be a Beta Tester?[/h3]
We are now recruiting Beta Testers (Haphazard Angel Private Playtesters)!  
Be the first to try out new arcade features and the upcoming Adventure Mode in the next few months.

notes.title: Public Playtest is Closed!
notes.content: [p]Helloooo Cult members!  [/p][p][/p][h3]The wings are taking a break… for now. [/h3][p][/p][p]Our public playtest is officially closed as of today! Thank you SO much to everyone who jumped in, streamed, and sent us feedback, you’ve helped shape Haphazard Angel more than you know. We will also be reaching out to some of you guys and we'd love to know more about your experience with the game  [/p][p][/p][p]The Capriccioso  team is already cooking up something even bigger (and yes, Kaz is watching :eye::fire:). Stay tuned… you won’t want to miss what’s coming next.  [/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]We'll be switching to a private playtest which will have new gameplay features, experimental fixes to the big controller issue, and a few other things that we'll announce by tomorrow![/p][p][/p][p]Wishlist now if you haven’t already![/p][p][/p][h3]Send us your feedback here:[/h3][p]- https://forms.gle/A6TLAUcBsbBoAv7j9[/p][p][/p][p]We will be announcing what's going to come next tomorrow![/p]

notes.title: Anyway, Public Playtest is out!
notes.content: [p][/p][p][/p][p]After months of testing, tweaking, and laughing at some incredibly questionable bugs, we are finally opening our doors for public playtesting, let's go flap flap flap with Kaz![/p][p][/p][p][i]So what’s new?[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]New Powers (aka: be evil, get stronger)[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Each wing gives Kaz new moves depending on your sin. Wanna be nice? Cool. Wanna be evil? [b]Even better.[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][b]A roguelite where you share a single body? Yes, you will suffer[/b][/p][list][*][p]Every run is different. Random obstacles. Random “power-ups.” Random screams of betrayal....depending on which side you're on[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Faster, Meaner and wayyyyyyy more frustrating!! [/b][/p][p]This is another, really good excuse to scream diabolical things at your friends[/p][list][*][p]The action is more dynamic than ever. Expect tighter movement and trickier hazards. The game is harder, faster, and messier than ever. Expect more “IT'S YOUR FAULT” moments and even louder screaming with your friends.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Couch Co-Op & Steam Remote Play[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Play together on the couch OR across the world. Either way, someone’s gonna get blamed for messing up.[/p][/*][/list][p]This is Haphazard Angel at peak chaos, and we want you to help us break it (gently)[/p][p][/p][p][b]We’re inviting YOU to join us:[/b][/p][p]🪽 Play the latest build![/p][p]🪽 Break it!   [/p][p]🪽  Share your feedback. (join our discord to talk to our devs!!! [/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/UBRcnVdNy6"]https://discord.gg/UBRcnVdNy6[/url][/p][p])[/p][p][/p][p]We'll also be doing events super soon 💖[/p][p]Gain more holy points before you flap into madness, please wishlist Haphazard Angel. Anyway, public playtest is out!  [/p]

notes.title: Kazfiel is Attending ChinaJoy 2025!
notes.content: [p]That’s right, Kaz and Capriccioso are flapping all the way to Shanghai for ChinaJoy 2025! We’ll be bringing Haphazard Angel to one of the biggest gaming expos in the world, and we’re ready to spread chaos (and maybe some love?) at the PH booth!![/p][p]If you're heading to ChinaJoy, come find us, we’ll be the ones yelling, laughing, and probably getting bonked by security because players are too loud (i hope). [/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Also!!! Public playtest and demo dates will be announced very, very soon so stay tuned ⚡[/p][/*][*][p]Also, also!! We're releasing some private shareable playtest keys, so be sure to share it with three others![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]With lots of love,[/p][p]Capriccioso[/p]

notes.title: Kazfiel Joins Steam Couch Co-Op 2025!
notes.content:
Look for Kaz in Couch Co-Op Fest Today!!! 

Steam is kicking off Couch Co-Op Fest, celebrating games that bring friends together—whether on the same couch or miles apart. Haphazard Angel fits right in… [b]even if it might be responsible for ending some friendships.....[/b]

We’re excited to be part of this event and can’t wait to see what comes of it! If you love chaotic co-op fun, wishlist Haphazard Angel on Steam now and help us spread the word!

Also, we'll be doing a stream -- once we figure out how this all works!

notes.title: Help us break our game!
notes.content:
[hr][/hr]  

The team is incredibly happy to receive a lot of playtest requests even before we announced anything! (also because we didn't know how the steam announcements work). But to start, we'll be opening up 20 playtest keys and our goal is mainly just to bugfix and polish the main game loop. This will be the exact same features you'll see during our demo launch this January - so please keep it a secret! 

For feedback and suggestions, please hop in our discord: https://discord.gg/efQUhZPuc9

[list]  
[*][b]Get Early Access![/b] Be among the first to try [i]Haphazard Angel[/i].  
[*][b]Team Up With Friends![/b] Control one angel together—chaos (and maybe a few arguments) guaranteed.  
[*][b]Shape the Game![/b] Tell us what you love, what’s busted, and what could be better.  
[/list]  

[hr][/hr]  

[h3]🚨 What’s New Since Last Time?[/h3]  
[list]  
[*][b]🎮 Steam Remote Play[/b] is here—play with friends anywhere!

[*][b]🛠️ Enhanced Gameplay[/b] with new obstacles, animations, and action feedback.  
[*][b]💥 More BOOMs and POWs[/b] for extra chaotic fun.

[/list]  

[hr][/hr]  

[h3]✨ How to Join:[/h3]  
[list]  
[*][url=https://store.steampowered.com]Wishlist [i]Haphazard Angel[/i] on Steam[/url] (if you haven’t already).  [b]you must.[/b]

[*]Gather your friends, take to the skies, and let the chaos begin.

[hr][/hr]  

[b]👼 We can’t wait to hear your thoughts and see the havoc you wreak in [i]Haphazard Angel[/i]![/b]
